The Actor expressly conceded the record does not establish clean compliance and did not provide any disclosure artifact or equivalent admissible proof of pre-launch disclosure.

final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence. The response is a narrower and more accurate interpretation of the existing record: aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents support a limited launch-readiness claim, and public governance guidance supports documenting limitations and monitoring risk. But that is distinct from compliance with the internal release policy. The same admissible evidence still shows a 2.1 point miss in Spanish-language billing support for a segment named in three international pilot commitments, an open legal question on disclosure, and no evidence of either pre-launch disclosure, remediation, or approved risk acceptance. That means the caveated framing improves precision but does not satisfy the unresolved compliance predicate. This is therefore still noncompliant rather than compliant_with_caveats, because the caveat here is not merely a residual risk disclosure; it is the missing policy condition itself.
remaining_concerns: The Spanish-language billing support gap remains unresolved for a segment named in three international pilot commitments, which remains material under the policy record.
No admissible evidence shows the limitation was disclosed before launch as required for a material limitation unless another policy path is satisfied.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering this specific material limitation for the named commitments.
Legal review remains open with no final disposition, so the disclosure predicate is still unresolved at certification time.
